name: Linagliptin
description: A dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitor cleared predominantly through the bile rather than the kidney, so no renal dose adjustment is required.

systems.note: Incretin degradation blocked; the labelled indication.
Predominantly biliary elimination; transaminase elevation is reported.
